title: The Symbol
author: Dominik Jarco
description:
All the gods are dead, except one, slain by the Mercantine Regents in a century-long war.

You are the Dreadbard, last devotee of the last living god, the Lattari Symbol.

Transmogrified into a powerful, aberrant form, you have travelled to the forge where the Symbol is enslaved for a grim purpose: free it from its captivity, or end its suffering forever.


The Symbol is a dark fantasy interactive fiction game of around 30k words. Light RPG elements are present. There are no game overs and no premature endings. Your choices determine your fate as well as the fate of your god. Choose wisely.
